title: Amarillo A Series Fan Drives-A20
description: The Amarillo A Series A20 gear drives are designed as replacements for the Marley Cooling Tower gearboxes. Cooling tower replacement parts from ICST.

paragraphs: The Amarillo A Series A20 right angle cooling tower gear drives are designed as direct replacements for the Marley Cooling Tower line of right angle drives. There are no differences in the critical mounting dimensions of the A Series making gear drive replacements easy. The gear housing foot-patterns, input shaft diameters and keyways are identical so existing couplings and drive shafts do not have to be replaced.
